name: Homeward Stone (Verdant)
description: A moss-flecked heartwood seed-stone with a leaf rune glowing emerald. It hums faintly near living trees, and pulls toward the waystone in Verdant's glade.
notes: Use it to teleport to the waystone in Verdant's town square. It isn't used up.
All Homeward Stones share one charge: after any of them carries you, none works for a week.
Not in a fight, a dungeon or a party. Using one on the road abandons the trip. No time passes.
Sold by the vault keeper in Verdant.
